PtSituationElement.Summary: High Peak 58 temporary timetable 25 July to 30 October 2026
PtSituationElement.Description:
High Peak 58 temporary timetable 25 July to 30 October 2026
An upcoming major road closure affecting service 58 will require the bus to divert and operate to a temporary timetable.
The closure will affect the A54 Macclesfield Road which will prevent the service from accessing the Cat & Fiddle to last between 25 July and 30 October 2026.
To maintain a service between Buxton and Macclesfield the bus will divert via Long Hill, Kettleshulme and Rainow with most journeys continuing beyond Macclesfield Bus Station to maintain a service to the Black Road area.
Due to the length of this diversion it is not possible for the 58 to maintain service provision to the Burbage area of Buxton during the period of the road closure.

Services 61, 61A and 61B
• From Bootle Bus Station will be as normal route to West Derby Village, then via Mill Lane, Barnfield Drive, Eaton Road, then as normal route to Aigburth. (Omits Town Row, Leyfield Road and Honeys Green Lane). Alternative bus stop: West Derby Village, near Meadow Lane and Eaton Road, near Honeys Green Lane.
• From Aigburth Vale will be as normal route to Eaton Road, then continue via Eaton Road, Barnfield Drive, Mill Lane, West Derby Village, then as normal route to Bootle Bus Station. (Omits Honeys Green Lane, Leyfield Road and Town Row). Alternative bus stop: Eaton Road, opposite Honeys Green Lane and West Derby Village, opposite Meadow Lane.
